title: Pump Shotgun (Fortnite)
blurb: One shot, one outcome, no further discussion required. Fortnite's pump shotgun was for years the most decisive weapon in the game — a single well-aimed blast could end a fight before either player finished building — and its crack is burned into millions of memories, usually as the last thing they heard before the lobby. Balance patches have argued about it for the best part of a decade. Play it to close arguments, edits, or anything else in need of immediate and non-negotiable resolution.
origin: The pump shotgun fire sound from Fortnite.
